omission.chore: Determine the supported Cloudflare R2 signer configuration for an S3 service connection.
omission.evidenceQuote: What is the officially supported signer configuration for Cloudflare R2 with service = “s3”?
omission.reason: This explicit configuration request is a concrete bounded service chore that could be evaluated as a small setup or diagnostic experiment; the draft excluded it without five-criterion assessment solely because it was one-off and technical, although the discussion contract accepts concrete tool requests and excludes only one-off bug reports.
